invariants.rationale: Method expects a non-null HoodieClusteringGroup parameter as it uses it immediately.
strategyParams is used to look up strategy parameters and create partitioners; null would likely cause errors.
instantTime is used as a clustering (replace commit) instant time and passed to internal methods.
getSlices() is called on clusteringGroup; must not be null for stream processing.
NumOutputFileGroups represents number of files to be created and should be positive.
